fixed: Original72 roots and six development dates, V41 fitted physical/working model, original truncated travel loss, all V50 four-cap-removed menus, original remaining candidate-generation restrictions, root-frozen common-wide station observations and remote relevant frames. No actual outcomes select or prune a candidate.
information: Actual actions consume only frames received by the current clock. Local observations from original station entry, legal boarding from original ready, simultaneous events together, no local absence after departure. All methods have the same physical menu and observation contract.

cheap_policies.cheap: Original shallow rolling_fixed onboard / combined waiting
cheap_policies.mean: Existing nominal onboard / rolling conditional-mean waiting
cheap_policies.pair: Existing rolling_fixed onboard / optimal frozen two-target waiting reference
cheap_policies.one_step: Existing one_step_rollout onboard / two-target waiting reference; finite policy improvement, not full adaptive optimum
cheap_policies.snapshot_csa: Deterministic connection scan on current W conditional operating endpoint means and lifted menu occurrences. Only declared transfer exits; no full-network recombination or new action. Invalid mean-time pairs are reported unavailable in the deterministic snapshot, never removed from the actual action domain. Not CSA-MEAT.

rollouts: Both change only the current onboard ALIGHT/CONTINUE choice and execute cheap platform control on the actual journey. Full128 and its explicit fallback force both current actions, then simulate the original shallow continuation with received remote messages frozen and the common local observation contract. Admitted matched mode uses the V45 frozen-child local kappa proxy: it has the same already received information, but does not integrate future common-local observation learning inside that tail proxy and is not a full-pi evaluation. It is admitted only when independent-prefix admission and maximum menu width<=6 hold; otherwise it explicitly falls back to full128 with the same bank and charged cost. No silent menu shrink.
randomness: Physical uniforms depend on the full dated graph's stable sorted trip ordinal, root index and world row; adding/traversing a menu cannot reassign existing trip tapes. The same public state yields the same bank for matched/full. Different public histories condition the same tapes differently. Archived actual execution uses the identical real event world for all methods.
choice: Original1e-9 strict finite-bank difference rule; if interval straddles zero or is tied, retain the cheap action. Unsupported or CPU-unfinished world pairs remain as full loss bounds in all128 rows. Sample-bank ranges are not population certificates.
measurement: One cold-policy rotated pass over all72 roots. Include model/history/menu-node/control setup, scoring, generation, rollout, observation updates, state logging and action publication. Shared V50 menu-generation cost is separately reported and also added to each full trip cost. Common archive and per-day graph preparation are outside query timing and separately recorded. No supplied answers reused for policy execution.
state_panel: Union every observed actual onboard/platform decision across all eight policies, retaining root identity, complete menu and public history, original entry/ready, visible and seen offers, legal actions and every source occurrence/action. Canonical JSON equality without hashes; no restriction to old148 states or seven certificate roots. Observation-only events stay in trace and history but are not artificial boarding opportunities.
validation: Cheap physical action sequence/loss/status must reproduce V50wide_common72/72. Every gate retains both128-row arms and future_messages=0; matched fallback and full rows compared where the same public state and complete bank occur. All lost/unsupported actual outcomes stay in the72-root denominator with full loss ranges.
retention_and_gate: Retain positive, negative, tied, incomplete and expensive runs. New same-menu policy comparisons are separate from descriptive old capped references. No G2 claim or V53new solver without a remaining natural policy gap and a genuine ordinary-solver limit. No server data, new dates, model fitting or paper rewrite.
